headlines.text: Rewind to 2024, when the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Will Ospreay vs. Brian Cage went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 7.30 ? a good, competitive contest. It was the 40th time the AEW International Title had been on the line, a real landmark for that championship. In the longest match of the night, Ospreay survived a deadlift superplex and a near-fall F10 before finishing Cage with the Hidden Blade to retain the International Championship.
Looking back to 2022, when it was Cassidy, Romero & Taylor's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.82 ? a match that delivered.
On this day in 2022, Silas Young made their first appearance under the AEW banner against Adam Page, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.80.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2024, when The Varsity Athletes (Trio) was no more, reborn as The Premier Athletes (Trio) after 3 matches, on Collision.
Looking back to 2022, when Hiroshi Tanahashi skipped the warm-up and went straight to headlining on debut, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.24.
2024 brought us this moment: it was a welcome sight as Big Bill returned to the ring after just under 3 months away, appearing on Collision.
